message:
The other day, we were packing for a weekend camping trip and stumbled upon our old go-bags tucked away in the closet. As we rifled through them, we realized we hadn’t updated the contents in ages! It turned into a fun little project where we not only refreshed our supplies but also discovered items we had forgotten about—like a trusty flashlight and some granola bars. 🌟 

This little win reminded us how staying prepared can be as simple as checking in on what we already have. It felt great to know we’re a step ahead, even for just a spontaneous adventure. 

What’s a small win you've had that made a difference in your own readiness journey?
